user.title: TeslaMate database
user.description: Connect to the PostgreSQL database TeslaMate logs to. The cards read it directly; nothing is written. A read-only role is recommended — see the documentation.

data_description.host: Use 127.0.0.1 if PostgreSQL runs on the same machine as Home Assistant.
data_description.password: Leave empty if the database accepts this user without a password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect, or the user cannot read TeslaMate's tables. Check the host, port, credentials, and that pg_hba.conf allows this user from Home Assistant.
error.no_cars: Connected, but this database has no cars in it — is it really TeslaMate's database?
